data.gender_notes: Daniah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Daniah is a beautiful Arabic name for girls, derived from the Arabic word 'danaya' which means 'to delight', 'to please'. The name Daniah is a variation of this name and is used in various Middle Eastern languages. It is often interpreted as a 'gift from God', 'gracious gift' or 'delightful one'. The name Daniah carries the meaning “Delightful, Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daniah usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
